additional_info.subject: Re: ID0449895-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / R3 170001567]Charger not working when damp CRM:02888000232 - Ticket 139639
additional_info.body:
Dear Mr. Vermeulen,
I am reaching out from the Technical Support Team in regards of ticket
ID0449895.
Thank you very much for providing me with timestamps of the issue.
I checked the logs from our charger, and identified the issue. The outlets went OoO for two reasons:
loss of communication between our SECC and PLC
Error coap polling
(
Internal communication to SECC lost for small interval of time.)
For both issues, the solution is to update the charger to our latest FW version v8.0.5. This version contains a new FW version for our SECC, which has hardening patches on communication and resolution of error coap polling.
If you agree, I will proceed to perform the update of the charger, from the current v6.0.3 > v7.0.5 > v8.0.5.
Looking forward to hearing feedback from you!
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
